chain.claim: Habitual Starbucks app users who experienced >8 minute delays at pilot stores in January will divert to competitor mobile apps (notably Dutch Bros $1 Order Ahead or Dunkin's $1 bundle) at the start of February; their return to Starbucks depends on the competitor's service quality.

In-store café visitors at pilot Starbucks locations, having experienced improved and more predictable wait times in January, will reinforce this behavior by choosing these locations more frequently for occasions valuing a reliable in-store experience.
Time-pressed commuters will continue to check the Starbucks app but will more readily divert to Dutch Bros or Dunkin’ if the quoted pickup time risks lateness.

Time-pressed commuters check app and divert if a delay risks lateness. In-store café visitors continue, with increased visit frequency if wait times improve.

(3) Commuters remain app-checkers but will increasingly divert to competitors or home prep if Starbucks’ quoted pickup times threaten lateness. No segment weights are assigned, but all behaviors are present in the simulated market.
